card.title: Nintendo Switch Console appears to have no power, but makes sounds when touch screen is tapped Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Console appears to have no power, but makes sounds when touch screen is tapped Repair

symptoms: appears dead but makes sounds on touch

claims.statement: A Switch that seems dead but makes sounds when the touchscreen is tapped is a display path fault: check the LCD and backlight for damage or liquid, and check for shorts around the LCD driver left of the LCD connector (83160722).

procedure: Inspect LCD, backlight ribbon and connector.
Check for shorts around the LCD driver.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
